name: landing-06-close
prompt: Show the last screen of this same landing page, at the bottom of the page. Keep the identical thin top navigation bar (the S logo and "Smart-Clearance", the links, "Sign in" and the green "Book a demo" button) and the same visual system, fonts and miniature-diorama photography. Replace everything below the navigation. Below the navigation: 1) On the pale sage-white ground, a left-aligned heading in the heavy dark display type, "Start with one distributor.", and three white plan cards in a row with thin hairline edges: "Pilot" with the lines "One distributor", "Up to 10 SKUs", "90 days"; "Growth" with "Every distributor in a region", "All ten agents", "Your sign-in"; "Enterprise" with "Every region", "Your SSO and data residency", "A named team". Each card ends with the grey line "Prices on request". 2) Under the cards, a wide rounded closing band filled edge to edge with a tilt-shift miniature diorama of the same Indian town at dusk, warm lights in the shops, and in the middle the giant cardboard carton now standing empty with its flaps open, a few tiny people waving beside it. Over the darker sky part of the band, the large white heading "Give your next batch a second chance." and two buttons, green "Book a demo" and white "Watch the 6-minute demo". 3) A footer on the sage-white ground: the S logo and "Smart-Clearance" on the left with the line "Every near-expiry carton gets a second chance."; three small link columns, "Product: How it works, Agents, Pricing", "Customers: Munchly Foods", "Sign in: Find your workspace, Staff console"; and a bottom line in small grey text, "Prototype · every company, person and number is fictional · Google AI Hackathon 2026". Miniature diorama photography for the closing band; crisp flat interface for everything else; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Closing screen: three plan cards (Pilot, Growth, Enterprise) each marked 'Prices on request', a wide band of the miniature town at dusk with the carton standing empty and the heading 'Give your next batch a second chance', and the footer.
